But the Stasi’s fearsome Friedrich Baumann has been observing Martha. When he makes a request of her, how can she refuse?

programme.title: Honey
programme.desc: Having survived her close brush with Friedrich, Martha investigates Hermann’s murder with Kurt. A sceptical Friedrich orders his men, the inept Otto and Rolf, to also investigate it. After the Stasi seize Hermann’s notebook, Martha and Kurt must infiltrate his workplace, a strange sausage factory. They meet Kamilla, his sweet colleague – will she be the key to locating Greta? Meanwhile, now a fugitive, a terrified and confused Greta is running out of options for refuge. Where can she turn?

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: In this special episode, four well-known Radio DJs go head-to-head at one of Britain’s biggest antiques fairs to raise money for charity. Hoping to spin loads of profits are BBC Radio 2’s OJ Borg and his teammate Melvin Odoom opposite BBC Asian Network’s Nikita Kanda and Radio 1’s Maia Beth. Let’s hope their antiques experts Izzie Balmer and Nick Hall are on the same wavelength as they hunt for bargains among the stalls. A brass pipe sparks a conversation about foreign languages for the reds, but are they speaking the right lingo when it comes to negotiating a good price on some Scandinavian jewellery? Across the fair, Nikita and Maia take a shine to a tatty footstool in the form of a bulldog, but Nick doubts it has any pedigree, and the musical blues compose their own Bargain Hunt song as they try to drum up a profit. At the auction in Chippenham, Izzie confounds her team with a Japanese bonus buy, while Nick hopes his will take off with the bidders.

programme.title: Blue Planet III

programme.title: See Hear
programme.desc: Marios Costi presents a programme exploring deaf education: where it began, how it has changed and what the future could hold for the next generation. Marios is joined by Martine Monksfield, teacher of the deaf, former president of Batod and long-standing campaigner for improvements in deaf education. Together, they discuss the changes taking place across education, the importance of language and communication, and the need to protect the rights of deaf children, including those with additional needs.

programme.desc: Game show in which 24 players compete to score points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the Impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day. In each episode, there are three rounds, and the three highest scorers from each round play against each other in the final. The winner of this battle faces a £10,000 question.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents the quiz show where a team of four friends – in this episode, Jacqui, Nigel, Phil and Jane – take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category. Each crossing has 32 potential steps, including 22 truths and ten lies. They must cross the Bridge by stepping on the truths and avoiding the lies, earning money for each correct answer. Step on a lie and the Bridge will halve their money, step on three lies, and they are out of the game. There is always a safe path across the Bridge. They just have to find it. Once they have each faced the Bridge on their own, those who have been successful will join forces to face the final crossing for a chance to take home the cash.

programme.desc: This series charts the contrasting fortunes of British fishing boats over the course of one brutal week. Each skipper must hunt the catch 24/7 if they are to earn a wage for themselves and their crew. It's the most dangerous job in Britain, and failure means risking your life for no reward. In this episode, it’s the last trip before Christmas and, with demand surging, fish prices are rising. Off the south coast of Cornwall, Ocean Pride is heading out in pursuit of pollock among the old sunken shipwrecks of the English Channel. 380 miles away on the Yorkshire coast, crabber Tydus is preparing to head out with hopes of a big pay day. The aim is to put six tons in the tank, a catch that this week could fetch well over £30,000. Off the south coast of Devon, Margaret of Ladram, one of Brixham’s most successful beam trawlers, is on the hunt for one of the most lucrative species in British waters, Dover sole.

Nineteen generations have lived here, employing local people to work at the house and vast estate. Antiques experts Christina Trevanion and Will Axon find a selection of antiques and collectibles to take to auction. Christina is drawn to a 1950s toy pedal car, and Will finds a Mouseman tray. In this episode: Tim Whewell reports from eastern Libya, where a vast reconstruction programme led by the Haftar family is transforming cities and reshaping the country's political future. As new roads, housing projects and landmarks emerge, we examine whether stability and development are outweighing concerns about accountability and democratic change. Plus: we follow Zaher, a young Sudanese boy whose life was changed by war when a drone strike left him severely injured. programme.title: Cooking Buddies
programme.desc: Get your dancing shoes ready because Buddy and Conker get a call from Jaylen, a young salsa dancer who doesn’t stop moving! His mum is a professional salsa dancer, and Jaylen has learned all his moves from her, as he loves connecting with their Colombian roots through dancing. But there’s one thing that Jaylen loves even more... eggs! He asks Buddy to teach him an egg-cellent meal that he can make for his family. Buddy knows that if Jaylen loves dancing salsa, then he has to get him making salsa too, so he comes up with a cracking egg tortilla wrap filled with guacamole and zingy salsa. They learn to make their own tortilla dough in minutes, an omelette that sticks to the tortilla in the pan and colourful tomato salsa and creamy guacamole – cracking! Jaylen’s keen to get Buddy learning his kind of salsa too, so Buddy learns the basics of posture and footwork with the help of Jaylen… and some colourful socks! Join Buddy, Conker and Jaylen in this episode of Cooking Buddies that gets salsa onto your plate and into your step. You can get all of Buddy’s recipes, and loads more, at bbc.co.uk/food

Every time they do this, his daughter notices and tells him to put his hat back on. In the end the lady takes her scarf and ties it around her dad's head to keep his hat on! The Very Important Lady visits the boat, only to fall apart. The Twirlywoos put her back together, but every time they think she's fixed, a piece of her falls off and the Twirlywoos have to put it back on again.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Educational series using Makaton sign language. Today, Justin goes shoe shopping. Mr Tumble visits Shopkeeper Tumble at The Shop with the Lot for pair of new red boots!

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: The Teletubbies bounce on the Tubby Bouncy. Po bounces as high as a cloud, then Laa-Laa bounces higher, Dipsy bounces even higher and Tinky Winky bounces highest of all.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Nigel and Baby Bear welcome babies Roman, Rose-may, Eliza, Theo, Joseph, George, Gracie and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are oranges which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding baby-appropriate oranges inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun rhyme ‘Juicy Orange’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: I Spy, You Spy
programme.desc: Elsee plays I-spy whilst on a beach walk with Mohamoud.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: When Nana and Dado ask Maddie and Triggs to help prune Mum's willow tree, they are shocked to learn that this means cutting off all its branches! Their shock soon turns to delight when they learn pruning will help the tree, and they are even more delighted by all the wonderful things Dado can make with the branches.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: Rebecca has a new pet plant called Stan, which gives Murphi a monster idea for the first make – a terrifically tropical bug made from a reused plastic bottle. The Mini Monsters make bottle fish, and Rebecca’s great aunt makes a silly plant for her pet bug. The Recycling Express brings some egg boxes to the attic – just the thing Murphi needs to make a snippy snappy egg box crocodile. The Tiny Helpers add the teeth and eyes, meaning the crocodile can join the attic’s jungle band for a final dance.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion
programme.desc: Stop-frame animated series featuring Raa Raa and his friends, who solve very noisy mysteries in the Jingly Jangly Jungle. Raa Raa wants a partner for a noisy stompy dance. All the animals have their own way of dancing, apart from Zebby, who says she is too shy to dance - or is she?

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: While away camping, Bluey makes a new friend called Jean-Luc. Despite speaking different languages, they come up with a great game. Bluey is sad when Jean-Luc goes home unexpectedly but learns that even if friendships are fleeting they can still mean a lot.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: When the Squirrels see Duggee practising his topiary skills, they are keen to give it a go. After going through the rules for safely using clippers, they are ready to snip a bush into a tidy ball. But their imaginations take control when they learn that they can do lots of different shapes! The Squirrels create an array of various shaped trees and bushes. But where is Tag? He has driven his topiary car into the Wild Woods! There is only one way to find him amongst the overgrown trees and bushes – by taming them! The Squirrels put their topiary skills into practice, transforming the wild woods into a magical topiary paradise. Eventually, they find Tag asleep in a bed he has pruned himself.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: George wants to find out all about prawns in today’s episode. Chantelle meets some new friends at the beach and heads to the rock pools to search for prawns, whilst Rory goes to the north of Scotland to meet a local expert at the harbour. Chantelle and Rory’s fact files help answer all of George’s questions. With the help of the Teeny Tiny Creatures poem, we discover that, like lots of other teeny tiny creatures, prawns are superheroes and help our planet in their own special way. In the Teeny Tiny Task, Chantelle and the children play at being prawns with a game of 'What’s the Time, Mr Fish?'

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Eden and Ava set up a beauty salon and make their very own face mask mixture. Dad pops along for a beauty treatment, but will his visit leave him feeling relaxed? Later, the family heads to the park for a game of hide-and-seek, and a cheeky squirrel decides to join in the fun.

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Jen and Small are off to a disco, but they need to finish dusting before they can go. Cinderella visits the cafe, Small flies off to see how pumpkins grow, and the chefs make pumpkin slippers for their magical friend.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Kika is a golden Labrador and a guide dog for her owner Dr Amit, who is blind. She is trained to use her supersight to help him do as many things as he can by himself. Together, they make the best team! Kika needs to help Dr Amit catch a train to the city. First, they must walk to the station. Kika knows the way like the back of her paw, but there are some important things they must do along the way. Kika has to help Dr Amit navigate a pelican crossing, using a top-secret cone to cross the road safely. Then she must guide him through the station and up the escalator to the platform. There are some hazards to avoid, including a tumbling box full of Kika’s favourite snacks - carrots! Then, at the station, their mission is almost derailed by a last-minute platform change. Can Kika’s supersight save the day?

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet the largest amphibians in the world, the Chinese giant salamander. They watch these secretive creatures emerge from their underwater rock shelters and use their amazing, superfast strike to grab their breakfast. Next, they meet a pair of Alaotran gentle lemurs. These beautiful creatures live in only one place in the wild – on the island of Madagascar. These two animals are very different, but Aneeshwar and Lizzie discover what the unusual and extraordinary wild connection is between them.

programme.title: What’s in Your Bag?
programme.desc: Midwife Marley shows us how her foetal heart scanner can pick up the sound that a baby’s heart makes inside its mummy’s tummy.

programme.title: Waffle's After School Club
programme.desc: Two new additions arrive at the club, Pepper and a magical Book Corner. When Waffle can’t join in with the bouncy castle fun, the after schoolers help everyone feel included.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Bernie needs a new shell. Oona and Silky find him the perfect replacement.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: Stripes and Toad see a beautiful sunrise and decide to write a song about it together. But Stripes wants the song to be rocky, while Toad wants it to be slower. They fall out and go off to write their own songs separately. Can Yukee help them become friends again and create one song together?

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: Lu learns that she can’t be upset with someone for doing something she has also done.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Cherry asks the Piggies to make a relaxing bench for Brian to rest on. Wilf, the self-appointed relaxation expert, offers to help. The bench ends up being anything but relaxing - it goes haywire!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Are you sitting comfortably? Then we'll begin a bedtime story all about the first five Numberblocks. Learn all about the numbers one, two, three, four and five with Numberblocks One to Five.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: W wants to be a superhero, like his superhero, X. But saving Alphablocks is not as easy as it looks, especially when they don't need saving. Until the mighty Box Man arrives. This episode introduces the letters W and X, and the words web, ox, bog, box, six and wet.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Ben meets friends Thomas and Theodore to do some baking in the kitchen. Mr Tumble is busy getting ready for a celebration, but he has forgotten something important. There is a tea party in this spotty surprise. Featuring signs for the words bowl, invitation and cake.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po enjoy Tiddlytubbies Songtime. Then it is time for Teletubbies Songtime. The Teletubbies sing solo before singing all together.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how hedges play an important role in the environment. They find out that hedges are a shelter for all types of animals and insects, and that they can help reduce air and noise pollution. On the way, they look closely at what’s living in a hedge, before pretending to be animals looking for a hedge to hide in!

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: In today's episode, Maddie is at a train museum finding out how signal boxes work and how trains are moved from one track to another to get to the right place. Maddie puts her special camera on the front of a train so we can see what happens to the points when the train switches from one track to another. Next, Maddie visits a paint factory to find out how paint is made. She uses her special camera to see inside the huge mixing vat where all the different ingredients are being mixed together, and we see how a computer is used to make all the different colours.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies' very own motorbike rider, Grace, shows off three amazing machines that work in sustainable forests! Grace helps drive a tree harvester, shows off an amazing tree-planting machine and then gathers logs with a tree-forwarding machine.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: It’s Miss Gerrard’s birthday, and the children plan a surprise party for her. Felicity and Coen are the chefs. They are in charge of baking and decorating a delicious birthday cake, with help from Mrs Bailey. Theo and Jasper are making a beautiful birthday crown for Miss Gerrard to wear and have asked Mrs Hussain to help them. With everything ready, it’s time for the surprise party!

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Animated deep sea adventure series. Captain Barnacles and his intrepid band of explorers roam the oceans in search of adventure and fun. The Octonauts recruit a shape-shifting mimic octopus to help them recover an important vial of medicinal algae from a moray eel's lair.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Peter and his friends try to find the perfect place to eat the radishes they took from Mr McGregor's garden, but there is a radish robber on their tails!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: Nugget plays big sister to a kid penguin for the summer. But when her hyper-energetic plans for fun activities prove unpopular, Pancake suggests an alternative approach.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: There are odd noises in the supermarket. Supertato discovers that Evil Pea and the Mini Peas are asleep and walking through the supermarket. Supertato tries to get them back to bed.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: It's the Ducklings' big day of outdoor activities, but Weasy is too tired after staying up all night playing video games. Can he find a way to wake up and come through for the Ducklings?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: It’s secret agent time when Mojo and Bo think Didi the tractor is up to something fishy. But can the two super secret spies follow her without being spotted?

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Dad whinges that Bluey and Bingo are too different, so Bluey plans to make them more alike

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey wants to help Dad make Bingo's birthday cake, but first she must put away her toys.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: The doctors become teachers at Dragon School for the day. Zog gets distracted entertaining the dragons and puts Pearl in danger of catching arcticosis, a deep-freeze condition.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: PC Plum jumps to conclusions when he hears about an upcoming volcanic eruption. But little does he know, it's Ava’s science project that’s set to fizzle in a safe experiment.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi wishes for help making a special breakfast for her dads, but when two lively chefs take over and make a mess, she realises it doesn’t have to be complicated to be special.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo needs to find different-coloured leaves to complete her nature tick-book, but she can’t find a green one. What will she do? Luckily, Gran Gran has a Gran Gran Plan that involves a special leaf rubbing!

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Sarah and her best friend Duck embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Sarah needs some new shoes, but picks out a very unusual pair.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Mother Clanger has grown a beautiful new flower. But when Tiny, Small and Major see it they realise it is the source of the horrible smell they have been experiencing.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa show Gramma Leeba a photo of themselves and match the pose. On the way to the Play Tree, they spot shapes in the clouds. They choose a picture book to play with and match the shapes to each other and all their friends. The game is easy for MeMo, but BaBa needs a little more help. MeMo kindly helps BaBa to play the game until it’s time for BeddyByes.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: In a magical forest, colourful characters have adventures and are read bedtime stories. The Tombliboos' trousers get mixed up all over the place - in the Ninky Nonk, in the Pinky Ponk. No matter how often the Tombliboos change their trousers back, it happens again.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Join JB for a Bedtime Story as we find out how families can come in lots of different shapes and sizes.

programme.title: This Is CBeebies
programme.desc: Programmes start at 6.00am.
